key_insight: Private score estimation achieves nearly matching upper and minimax lower error bounds, clarifying the privacy–accuracy trade-off and enabling near-optimal private diffusion modeling.
engineering_relevance: The resulting diffusion model provides differential privacy independent of the number of denoising steps, avoiding step-dependent privacy accounting.
method: Represent scores with quadratic B-splines and sample a private estimator using the exponential mechanism.
Implement sampling through projected Langevin Monte Carlo with runtime polynomial in sample size.
Use the private score estimator in a suitably discretized diffusion model.
evidence_signal: The paper establishes theoretical error guarantees and reports validation on synthetic and real-world datasets; the abstract gives no numerical experimental results.
watch_item: Guarantees assume sub-Gaussian distributions with locally Hölder-continuous scores; polynomial runtime alone does not establish scalability in high dimensions.
paper_title: Differentially Private Score Estimation with Applications to Score-Based Generative Models
